duzeltme.govde: In gene R, a mutation changes the first two nucleotides of intron 1 from GU to AU. As a result, the spliceosome does not recognize intron 1, and the 90-nucleotide intron remains in the mature mRNA. Exon 1 ends with a complete codon. When read in the same frame as exon 1, the retained intron contains its first stop codon, UGA, at intron nucleotides 31–33. Which outcome is most likely?
